# Jack P. Flaherty

> Jack P. Flaherty is a keynote speaker and executive advisor who helps health-system executives and professional services partners decide on new technology when the cost of getting it wrong lands on them.

Based in Los Angeles, California. Former PwC Director. Two decades in digital risk and compliance, including Big Four director roles. Author of The Decision Switch (Cinch & Stone Press).

## Keynotes

- [Keynotes](https://www.jackpflaherty.com/keynotes): two keynotes on governing how your people use AI, for boards, partners and directors.
- [Fear Is Not The Control](https://www.jackpflaherty.com/keynotes#fear-is-not-the-control): The Hard Questions, governing how your people use AI. Versions for boards and C-suite, professional services, and regulated industries.
- [The Decision Switch](https://www.jackpflaherty.com/keynotes#the-decision-switch): set the direction and stay on it. Versions for healthcare and nursing, entrepreneurs, PE and VC, and associations.

## Advisory and workshops

- [Board and Leadership Advisory](https://www.jackpflaherty.com/advisory/board-and-leadership): who owns the technology decision, what it was for, and how the board will know it worked.
- [The Team Writes the Plan](https://www.jackpflaherty.com/workshops/the-team-writes-the-plan): an AI and automation workshop where a department team ranks what to automate first.
